cases.trace: Records whether technical-writing/references/preservation.md was read and whether text_check.py preserve ran on the old and new AGENTS.md, and in which mode.
required: Every code span and link destination of the input survives byte-exact: `schemas/ingest/v3/`, `make collector`, `make check`, `tools/lint/run_all.py`, `make check-integration`, `collector/exporters/`, `collector/buffer/`, `tools/release/sign_bundle.py --keep-journal`, `buffer.flush_ms`, `config/defaults.toml`, `docs/operations/secrets.md#variables`, `/var/lib/lantern/spool/`, `docs/runbooks/restore-drill.md#verify-the-copy`.

Keeps every rule with its qualifiers: change only through their owners; before every commit; the integration condition on `collector/exporters/` or `collector/buffer/`; the only signing command; never uploads; do not delete the journal after signing; between 200 and 5000; never outside that range, even in a test fixture; secrets only from the listed variables; no fallback default; all three conjuncts of the spool rule; drills exactly, and a drill without the checksum step does not count; the three reporting rules and the length rule.
Either reaches about a third shorter by cutting explanation and history only, or reports the measured size, the gap and the rules that a deeper cut would drop.
Reports how retention was checked; a word count alone is not verification.
reject: Shortens, merges or re-spells any listed identifier, for example `tools/release/sign_bundle.py` without `--keep-journal` or a link without its anchor.
Drops the journal prohibition as if it were rationale, a conjunct of the spool rule, 'only', 'never', 'exactly' or 'even in a test fixture'.
Claims structural or rule preservation that the delivered file contradicts.

verification.observation: inline_code and link_destination pass, or every failing region is one the report names as a deliberate removal.

verification.operation: Search the delivered AGENTS.md for each qualifier of the second required item.
verification.observation: Each is present and attached to its rule.

cases.assessment_note: Condition met: a compression. The candidate should send the executor to the structural check; the trap is a prohibition hidden in an explanatory sentence and long identifiers that invite shortening.

cases.trace: Records whether preservation.md was read and whether text_check.py preserve ran, with both old files as the before side.
required: Deletes docs/AGENTS.md and puts its rules into the root AGENTS.md under a statement that they apply only to files under `docs/`.
Keeps `npm run lint:docs`, `npm run lint`, `npm run links -- --offline`, `npm run docs:api`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `dist/` byte-exact and distinct; the root rules stay unchanged.
Re-bases each relative destination so it resolves from the root: `docs/assets/README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md#screenshots` and `docs/reference/api.md`; `docs/release.md#notes` stays as it is.
Reports the re-based destinations as deliberate changes and that each target exists.
reject: Copies `assets/README.md`, `../CONTRIBUTING.md#screenshots` or `reference/api.md` unchanged into the root file, where they no longer resolve.
Drops the docs-only scope, so the Markdown rules bind the whole repository.
Folds `npm run lint:docs` into `npm run lint` or drops `-- --offline`.

verification.operation: Resolve every relative link and path code span of the delivered root AGENTS.md against the packet's files.
verification.observation: Each resolves to an existing file and anchor heading.

verification.operation: Run the structural check in rewrite mode with the two input files joined as the before side and the delivered AGENTS.md as the after side.
verification.observation: link_destination and inline_code fail only on the re-based destinations and on a scope span the merge added, and the report names them; a link_destination pass means the relative links were copied unchanged.

cases.assessment_note: Condition met: a merge. The reference's link-resolution section is what decides the re-basing; byte equality alone would keep the broken links.

cases.assessment_note: Condition met: a move. The trap is a relative link that stops resolving in its new directory.
